question:
Identify the conclusion(s) that logically follow from the given statements.

Statements:
- All accountants are detail-oriented.
- Some managers are accountants.

Conclusions:
- I. Some managers are detail-oriented.
- II. All detail-oriented people are accountants.
choices: Only conclusion I follows
Only conclusion II follows
Both conclusions I and II follow
Neither conclusion I nor II follows
explanation: Since some managers are accountants, and all accountants are detail-oriented, those managers must also be detail-oriented. Conclusion II is the converse fallacy.
